Other sub-42% pixel counts in the roadmap carry their own controls (item 87, PIPELINE_ROADMAP.md:10116-10121: re-render 0.02 %, copy and re-import 0.03 %, at shot_diff's threshold 8, where item 90's 42 % was at >2).
